intended_behavior: Change StockItem.quantity at field 2 from int32 to uint32 to represent nonnegative on-hand stock. Producer request.quantity remains a canonical signed decimal string in the signed int64 range; clamp it to [0, 4294967295] before encoding, without wrapping. Consumers expose the decoded uint32 quantity as a canonical decimal string. in_stock remains true exactly when decoded quantity is positive and decoded state is STOCK_STATE_UNSPECIFIED; quarantined and unknown states remain blocked. Preserve sku, optional label/route/state observations, labels and routing construction. Producer input and incoming payload are independent. No test edits. Coordinated rollout only; historical negative int32 payloads are outside the new input contract.
